FAQ

Your Questions Answered

Here are a few things people usually ask before we work together.

+

What kinds of products do you design?

A lot of my work has been in fintech and marketplaces, with AI and healthcare projects too. I enjoy the products where the problem isn't obvious at first.

+

What is your role in a project?

I try to understand the problem first. Then I map the journey, explore ideas, design the screens and work through the details with developers. Each case study shows what I worked on and what I can actually prove.

+

Do you work with remote teams?

Yes. I'm based in Brighton and have worked remotely with teams in different places. I like keeping communication simple, showing work early and talking through decisions together.

+

Can I see your references and credentials?

Yes. I've put the recommendation letters, awards and certificates on my Credentials page. You can read the original documents there.

+

How can I get started?

Send me an email at aabdulfataijamiu@gmail.com. Tell me a bit about what you're working on and where you need help. I'd be glad to talk.
